title: The data face extends to 9e20: the far C-channel rows sit on the three-term law, and the anchor semantics of the E1 clause are pure
body: Two corrections to the distance-to-Final ledger. (1) PURE COMPOSITION: if_E1V3_and_walk takes its E1 datum as an underscored, UNUSED premise (_hE3 : E1ClauseV3 q 7000) and composes straight through ZetaZeroSet.rhIfMarginZeta on the four Qside walk legs. The E1 clause is a DOCUMENTED DATA ANCHOR for the walk's M-side quantities (Mf/devOf/Bwire must ultimately be grounded in measured M), not a wire consumed in the proof. Consequence: the data-side frontier is exactly the domain the M-defect law is anchored on, and extending that domain IS extending the data clause. (2) FACE EXTENSION TO 9E20: the C/quad zeta channel (scripts/rh/zetac, s34 series - the mpmath RS wall on this machine is [9e18, 3e19)) already carries three census rows BEYOND the 0153 face: t = 3.0001046e19 (chain 3), 3.0001046e20 (chain 4), 9.0003138e20 (chain 5), each with the 0152-corrected eps = 0.704694914 and dps-stable I_far (dps 40/60/80 identical in f64). All three sit on the three-term closed-form law M = A3 ln t + B3 + C(U_TOP) t^2 (A3 = -25254354, B3 = 523472285, C = -1.0860681706e-29): residuals -1.306e4, -2.835e4, -4.284e5, all NEGATIVE. NEW PRECISION HAZARD (the third, after g^2-t^2 and repr-float): the M ASSOCIATION ITSELF (eps + logzeta - lm - la - re - I_far) is a cancellation at t >= 3e19 - lm and I_far are ~2.4e19..7.1e20 while M is ~1e10..9e12 - so each recorded M carries ~ulp(lm)/2 worst-case noise: 4096 / 32768 / 131072 at the three heights. The observed residuals are 3.2 / 0.87 / 3.3 sigma of those budgets, sign-consistent: the law is confirmed through the full measured face (G, 9e20] at channel-limited precision, with a residual systematic component ~1e4-scale still to be attributed (chain-4/chain-5 zeta cross vs the f64 association rounding). FRONTIER CORRECTED: the data-side open part is (9e20, inf), with (9e18, 3e19) as the dps-wall band (law-covered, rowless). CROSS-CHECK GAP: chain 3 has a bare-cosine cross (s34b_chain3.log; the 5e8G cross was 2.1e-5); chains 4 and 5 have NO independent zeta cross yet - they are the next data task (S20a). Clause state: the 0154 in-tree V3C window (G, 9e18] remains the conservative named hole; extending it to 9e20 (with B >= ~5e5) awaits the chain 4/5 crosses as a margin-gate. No RH claim.
